gemini.title: Organisation
gemini.abstract: Organisation is part of AddressBase Premium, published by Ordnance Survey. It represents organisation features using geometry geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Ordnance Survey as part of AddressBase Premium. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
